sentences.en: I think that dolphins should not be kept in captivity.
sentences.zh: 我认为海豚不应该被关在笼子里。

sentences.en: Dan finally released his hostage after two days of captivity.
sentences.zh: 丹终于在两天的囚禁后释放了他的人质。

sentences.en: The Vancouver aquarium will no longer keep whales and dolphins in captivity.
sentences.zh: 温哥华水族馆将不再把鲸鱼和海豚关押在水池里。

senses.zh: 被俘(的状态)，拘禁，囚禁；束缚

mnemonic: 词根记忆：capt（抓）+ivity（情况）→抓住→拘留
